title: How LiteSpeed + NVMe deliver up to 4x faster WordPress TTFB
excerpt: How we configure LiteSpeed Web Server, LSCache and enterprise NVMe hardware to cut server response times and pass Core Web Vitals.
content:
Time to First Byte (TTFB) is one of the most critical metrics impacting both user experience and search rankings in Google's Core Web Vitals algorithm. When visitors request a page from a WordPress site, Apache or generic Nginx proxies often take 400ms to 750ms just to execute PHP scripts, query the database, and deliver the initial byte.

Why LiteSpeed Outperforms Apache and Nginx

LiteSpeed Enterprise features direct, native integration with the Linux kernel and replaces Apache without requiring configuration changes. Combined with the LSCache plugin, full HTML pages are served directly from server-level memory cache, completely bypassing PHP execution and MySQL bottlenecks.

The NVMe Difference

Enterprise PCIe 4.0 NVMe drives deliver over 1,000,000 IOPS compared to standard SATA SSDs (capped at 90,000 IOPS). For WooCommerce stores and database-heavy WordPress blogs, this means instant query execution even during high-traffic sales events.

title: How to register a .BD domain with BTCL in 2026
excerpt: BTCL policies, required documents, DNS setup and the registration timeline explained step by step.
content:
Registering a .BD (Bangladeshi Top-Level Domain) is essential for local branding, trust, and search engine optimization in Bangladesh. However, because .BD is managed by Bangladesh Telecommunications Company Limited (BTCL), the process requires specific governmental documentation.

Required Documents for .BD

  • For Individuals: National Identity Card (NID) copy or Passport scan.
  • For Companies (.com.bd): Valid Trade License copy and Tax Identification Number (TIN).
  • For Educational Institutions (.edu.bd): Official approval letter from the Ministry of Education or UGC.

Host Divine offers paperless .BD verification so you don't have to visit BTCL offices physically. Simply submit your documents through our support portal after booking.

title: Scaling a white-label reseller hosting business
excerpt: How agencies configure WHM packages, private nameservers and billing to build recurring revenue.
content:
Web design agencies often make the mistake of handing their completed client sites over to third-party web hosts, missing out on predictable, high-margin monthly recurring revenue (MRR). With white-label cPanel/WHM reseller hosting, you can package website hosting, email maintenance, and daily backups together into your monthly retainer fees.

Best Practices for Resellers

  1. Set up private nameservers (ns1.yourdomain.com and ns2.yourdomain.com) for 100% brand anonymity.
  2. Use tiered cPanel package quotas (Starter, Pro, eCommerce) to enforce fair resource distribution.
  3. Automate invoicing using WHMCS or ClientExec.
